summary.text: Rupie Phillips is a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate from District 7, listed with Logan County; the district covers Logan, Lincoln and Boone counties and part of Kanawha. His legislative page lists committee assignments including Economic Development, Energy, Industry and Mining, Finance and Government Organization.

paragraphs.text: Phillips' page lists his education as Man High School, his occupation as sales manager, and his birthplace as Man, West Virginia.
It lists military service in the United States Air Force.
His affiliations include the National Rifle Association, Aracoma Lodge #99 AF&AM, Scottish Rite, Shriners, the Loyal Order of the Moose, the American Legion and Friends of Coal.
